literal_meaning: কঠিন (hard/difficult) পাল্লা (scale or side of a balance)
similar_in_english: between a rock and a hard place
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ব্যবসায়িক সংকটে কঠিন পাল্লায় পড়েছে।
যুদ্ধের সময় সৈন্যরা কঠিন পাল্লায় জড়িয়ে পড়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has fallen into a tough spot due to the business crisis.
During the war, the soldiers got entangled in a terrible danger.
note: The idiom draws from the metaphor of a balance scale where one side is heavily weighted, symbolizing imbalance and hardship in Bengali folklore and everyday language.
